questions.question: If a number 'X' is greater than 10 but less than 13, which of the following could be the number X?

options.explanation: 10 is not greater than 10.

questions.explanation: "X is greater than 10" means X > 10. "X is less than 13" means X < 13. So, X must be a number between 10 and 13 (not including 10 or 13).
